news.title: Founding Member Registrations Open for EAGLE 2.0 Community
news.summary: Founding member registrations are open ahead of the Pan-India community launch.
news.content: Founding member registrations are now open. Fill in your details and choose a plan on the Join Us page. The team reviews every application and follows up with plan and payment details. The community launches Pan-India on 1 January 2027.

news.title: Professional Wings & Specialized Initiative Framework Announced
news.summary: Each wing will run a monthly format and one annual summit.
news.content: The Executive Council has ratified conveners across all ten specializations. Each wing operates with autonomy while contributing to the unified national calendar.

news.title: Upcoming National Conclave & Registration Notices Announced
news.summary: Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Pune regional calendars announced.
news.content: City chapters will coordinate localized mixers, speed networking evenings, and direct engagements with regional ICAI branches.

news.title: Professional & Regulatory Update: Digital Tools and AI in Practice
news.summary: Insights and practical takeaways on digital reporting and modern advisory tools.
news.content: Subject-matter experts share analysis on emerging technology trends, compliance automation and digital transformation for CA firms.

testimonials.name: CA Rajesh Sharma
testimonials.designation: Senior Partner, Direct Tax & Corporate Advisory · New Delhi
testimonials.quote: EAGLE 2.0 brings together the best minds in the profession. The focused wing structure and technical masterclasses provide practical, real-world clarity on complex regulatory shifts that every practicing CA needs.

testimonials.name: CA Sneha Patel
testimonials.designation: Managing Partner · Women CA Network Lead · Mumbai
testimonials.quote: Being part of this community has unlocked incredible peer collaborations and leadership opportunities. The focus on mentorship, women professionals and wellness makes EAGLE 2.0 truly forward-looking.

testimonials.name: CA Amit Verma
testimonials.designation: Founder, AI & Financial Automation Practice · Bengaluru
testimonials.quote: The emphasis on AI, emerging technology and continuous learning is what sets EAGLE 2.0 apart. It is an indispensable platform for any professional aiming to build a future-ready practice.
